links.comparator_used: Token-level log-probability confidence (calibration audit, ECE) and the 90% target coverage; no direct head-to-head with another uncertainty method reported in the abstract
links.outcome: Empirical coverage of conformal prediction sets for LLM answers to Alzheimer's clinical questions, versus the 90% target
links.effect: GPT-4o and Claude Haiku 97.1% coverage; Mixtral-8x7B 95.7%; all above the 90% target. GPT-4o token-level confidence was miscalibrated (ECE = 0.213).
links.quote: GPT-4o and Claude Haiku showed empirical coverage of 97.1%.
